description:
The hospital has rebranded and needs its system configuration updated. 

Goal: Update the global hospital settings in HospitalRun.

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Administration section (gear icon or sidebar).
2. Find the General Configuration or Settings area.
3. Change the Hospital Name to: 'Grand Oak Community Hospital'
4. Change the Hospital Email to: 'admin@grandoak.org'
5. Save the configuration.

Note: Ensure the changes are saved successfully.
